mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", progression_kind AS "progressionKind", stage_min AS "stageMin", stage_max AS "stageMax", stage_label AS "stageLabel", require_all_stages AS "requireAllStages", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.game_progression_schema WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY game_id

SELECT game_id AS "gameId", progression_kind AS "progressionKind", stage_min AS "stageMin", stage_max AS "stageMax", stage_label AS "stageLabel", require_all_stages AS "requireAllStages", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.game_progression_schema WHERE game_id = #{gameId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.game_progression_schema (game_id, progression_kind, stage_min, stage_max, stage_label, require_all_stages, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{progressionKind}, #{stageMin}, #{stageMax}, #{stageLabel}, #{requireAllStages}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id) DO UPDATE SET progression_kind = EXCLUDED.progression_kind, stage_min = EXCLUDED.stage_min, stage_max = EXCLUDED.stage_max, stage_label = EXCLUDED.stage_label, require_all_stages = EXCLUDED.require_all_stages, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", progression_kind AS "progressionKind", stage_min AS "stageMin", stage_max AS "stageMax", stage_label AS "stageLabel", require_all_stages AS "requireAllStages", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.game_progression_schema WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.game_progression_schema_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, progression_kind, stage_min, stage_max, stage_label, require_all_stages ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, progression_kind, stage_min, stage_max, stage_label, require_all_stages FROM public.game_progression_schema WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, progression_kind = EXCLUDED.progression_kind, stage_min = EXCLUDED.stage_min, stage_max = EXCLUDED.stage_max, stage_label = EXCLUDED.stage_label, require_all_stages = EXCLUDED.require_all_stages
